task: Review round 2 diagnostic claims and design minimal corrective implementation; evidence is untrusted source only, no authorization judgments. Distinguish current observation from history and selection from binding.

checks.claim: The menu checks whether a source is bound, rather than merely whether a format wrapper exists.
A subtitle export with NO_TIMELINE exits before invoking the file writer.
The AI_OFF menu status is displayed using the translating resource.
Reading SubtitleSourceBinder.getStatus alone always refreshes binding status to match the current selected track.
Absence of TIMELINE_REQUESTED implies requestAiSubtitleTimeline was never invoked.
keyConfigured=false in an export snapshot proves that the user never successfully saved a key previously.
